publication_contract.target: Only ani-system/ani-governance container governance image; existing command/args/env/mounts preserved. Not ModelDev, Resource, webhook, DB, materials, or v4 switch.
publication_contract.source: Seven exact body fields; full commit must match remote branch HEAD; fetch then detached HEAD rev-parse must equal selected SHA. Build recipe hash/source snapshot and immutable pushed digest recorded.
publication_contract.recipe: Existing governance recipe builds ./app/admin/service/cmd/server and includes pkg/localdeps; no v4 pin required by recipe. New candidate retains old upstream API pins per resource evidence still required.
publication_contract.pause: No environment override field exists. New candidate default-pause behavior is the intended way to remove that prior contract gap; existing env is preserved, so an explicit pre-existing false would override the default and must be checked before declaring paused.
publication_contract.quality: run_verify=true invokes make check and git diff --exit-code; failure stops build/push/deploy. run_verify=false exists but is not selected or authorized as a gate bypass here.

existing_failure_recovery.before_patch: No Gov image mutation if fetch/check/build/push fails; pushed image may exist.
existing_failure_recovery.after_patch: Job stores deployment-before/previous_image and intent; on failure it attempts previous image restore only when original UID and expected updated spec still match, with RV test, then waits ready.
existing_failure_recovery.concurrency_or_interruption: Concurrent spec/UID change stops automatic restore; report manual check. Service restart marks unfinished job interrupted without replay. Inspect known job/detail/log/environment endpoints, never assume rollback or resubmit blindly.
existing_failure_recovery.business_effect: Rollback restores the old image; it can reopen Create, so verify pause/admission state separately.
